skills.name: Boundless Water (水无垠/水無垠)
skills.line: Worship not other deities and take refuge in the Buddha.
skills.description: SP Ungaikyou uses transforming water to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and decreases the duration of all on himself by 1 turn.

skills.name: Clear Mind (心净明/心浄明)
skills.line: The dust has been cleared away, and the true heart has been found.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Ungaikyou clears the dust from his mind. At the start of battle, increases the RES of all non-summoned allies by 25%. For each 30% of HP he has lost, decreases the onibi cost of his skills by 1. When he takes an action, redistributes the HP of all non-summoned allies, causing all allies to have the same proportion of HP. ;Upon Usage :SP Ungaikyou decreases the duration of all on a targeted ally by 1 turn.

upgrades.text: Increases the targeted ally's RES by 20% of his own initial RES, lasts for 2 turns.
Increases the targeted ally's move bar by 30%.
Boost to RES granted to the targeted ally increases to 30%.
If he fails to decrease the duration of on the targeted ally, increases their move bar is by 100% instead.

skills.name: All is Void (万法皆空/万方皆空)
skills.line: Like a bubble, an illusion, a phantom, or a dream. So is all conditioned existence to be seen.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
The wheel of life turns eternally. SP Ungaikyou deducts the HP of all non-summoned allies by 50% to grants them Mirror's Ward, which absorbs damage equal to 50% of their max HP. He Flips the HP of all non-summoned allies and removes their Mirror's Ward after 2 turns.
While this skill is on cooldown, increases the SPD of all non-summoned allies by 25%. ; Mirror's Ward (神鏡庇佑) : :'''Buff, Mark''': A non-dispellable shield. Increases RES by 30%. When it fails, recovers the HP of the ally by 25% of the remaining shield HP and increases SP Ungaikyou's SPD by 10, lasts for 1 turn. ; Flip (翻転) : Switches the current HP with with the HP lost.

upgrades.text: Proportion of HP after Flipping won't be lower than 20%.

bio.condition: With SP Ungaikyou win 30 times in {{Popup
